LanguageData.RimAgent.Placeholder: Tell the agent what to do, e.g. "set Alice's Doctor priority to 1"
LanguageData.RimAgent.ConfirmNote: The plan above is a preview — nothing has changed yet.
LanguageData.RimAgent.ToolsStripped: Tools were not available for this reply: the model that answered does not support tool calling, so nothing was changed.
LanguageData.RimAgent.CombatLatencyNote: Combat orders arrive several seconds after you speak. Use them for positioning and retreats, not real-time fighting.
LanguageData.RimAgent.NoFunctionCalling: None of the models in your RimLLM Framework fallback chain supports tool calling, so the agent cannot act. Adjust the chain in RimLLM Framework's mod settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.NoProvider: RimLLM Framework has no usable provider: {0}. Configure one in RimLLM Framework's mod settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.FrameworkTooOld: The installed RimLLM Framework is too old for RimAgent. Update it to a version from 2026-09-12 or later.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Error.Configuration: The LLM provider refused the request ({0}). Check the API key, credit and fallback chain in RimLLM Framework's mod settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Error.Transient: The request did not get through ({0}). Try again in a moment.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Error.ContextTooLong: The conversation is too long for the model. Press Clear and start again.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.PermissionsHeader: What the agent is allowed to do
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ObserveTip: Colony overview, colonists, resources, threats, research (status and switching), maps (listing and switching) and map object search.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.WorkTip: Change work priorities and daily schedules. Easy to undo by hand.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.BuildTip: Mark things for mining, cutting, harvesting, deconstruction and hauling, and place blueprints. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Combat: Combat — draft, move and attack orders
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.CombatTip: Draft colonists and give move or attack orders. The model needs several seconds to respond, so this is for positioning and retreats, not real-time control. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Trade: Trade — list stock, buy and sell, caravans
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.TradeTip: List what orbital traders and visiting caravans are selling, buy or sell in a single deal with the game's trade prices, and form player caravans. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.MedicalTip: Check colonist health (injuries, diseases, bleeding, operations) and change medical care levels. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.PrisonerTip: List prisoners and set their interaction mode (recruit, release, execution); recruitment and daily care still run through the game's warden mechanics. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AnimalTip: List animals, mark wild ones for taming, switch training on and off, and assign allowed areas. Taming and training run through the game's mechanics. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ZoneTip: List zones, add stockpile and growing zones, delete zones, and change what stockpiles accept. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ProductionTip: List work tables and their bills, add bills with a repeat count, and delete bills. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.MaxStepsTip: Stops a runaway loop from spending API credit. Applies immediately, even mid-game.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.RequireConfirmation: Confirm — approve Work / Build / Combat first
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.RequireConfirmationTip: When on, Work, Build and Combat tools only preview what they would do. Press Confirm to execute them. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutonomousHeader: Autonomy — the agent acts on its own
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutonomousTip: When on, the agent starts its own instructions: routine inspections plus raids, mental breaks and food shortages. Every run is logged and bounded by the daily budget below. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoOnMentalBreak: React to colonists near mental break
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.FrameworkNote: Provider, API key, model and fallback chain are configured in RimLLM Framework's settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goals.Title: Long-term goals — autonomous runs work toward these
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goals.Empty: No goals yet. Add one below, e.g. "research electricity".
